parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is made of durable plastic, shaped as a curved rod attached to the sides of the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, providing a comfortable grip and balance when filled with liquid or solid materials.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate around its hinge points on the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the bucket is a cylindrical container made of plastic, forming the main volume for holding contents.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for holding water, cleaning solutions, or other materials, providing structural support for the handle and stability when placed on surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed part and does not move; it remains stationary while the handle moves.
